preconditions.description: The number of rows in the table is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.
The number of columns in the table is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: Each character in the table is one of 'D', 'I', 'M', 'A'
preconditions.description: Each cell in the table contains one of the four letters.

postconditions.expression: output == 'Poor Dima!' or output == 'Poor Inna!' or output == integer
postconditions.description: The output is either 'Poor Dima!' if Inna cannot go through name DIMA once, 'Poor Inna!' if there is the infinite number of names DIMA Inna can go through, or a positive integer representing the maximum number of times Inna can go through name DIMA.
